search_text: published ZDI-21-1299 ZDI-CAN-14187 Ivanti Avalanche Filestore Management Arbitrary File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2021-11-18 CVE-2021-42125 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-42125 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Ivanti'] ['Avalanche'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileStoreConfig app. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Fixed in version 6.3.3. title: Ivanti Avalanche Filestore Management Arbitrary File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FileStoreConfig app. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
